description: Phase 2: organize / de-nuance. Collapse to ONE loop by removing the LAYA_FAST_LOOP flag and the LEGACY (pre-fast-loop) browser-loop path so the reviewed fast loop (merged in PR #8) is the single reliable path. Audit the ~30 LAYA_* env knobs in src/config.ts and delete/inline the ones that do not earn their place. Consolidate the decision pipeline in src/autopilot/loop.ts into one readable flow with fewer branches. Bias to DELETION. Every removal must be behavior-preserving for the KEPT (fast) path and the suite must stay green after each change. Do this AFTER FEAT-002/003/004 so the fixes are not entangled with the reorg.
steps: GROUND FIRST. Map every place fastLoop / fastWaitCapMs / the legacy branch is referenced (git grep -n 'fastLoop\|fastWaitCapMs\|captureFast\|canReuseFast\|prefetchedFast\|speculativeDecision' in src/). Key sites: src/config.ts (fastLoop/fastWaitCapMs fields, defaults DEFAULT_FAST_LOOP/DEFAULT_FAST_WAIT_CAP_MS, LAYA_FAST_LOOP/LAYA_FAST_WAIT_CAP_MS parsing), src/autopilot/loop.ts (~1289 option defaults, ~1416/1483-1497 capture branch, ~1799-1801 fast ctx threading, ~1861-1875 fast settle, plus F4 speculative-decision reuse gated on fastLoop), src/server.ts (~219-220 threading), src/tools/run_goal.ts (~96-98, ~316-317), src/browser.ts (captureFast import + act-time freshness/occlusion), src/snapshot.ts (captureFast). Also inventory benchmark/before-after.mjs + benchmark/RESULTS.md which reference LAYA_FAST_LOOP.

COLLAPSE TO ONE LOOP: make the fast path ALWAYS ON and remove the flag + the legacy branch. Concretely: in src/autopilot/loop.ts replace the `if (fastLoop) { ... } else { legacy capture/prefetch }` branching with the fast-loop body unconditionally; keep the F4 speculative-decision reuse and the freshness/occlusion guard as the single act path (they are the reviewed reliable mechanics). Keep fastWaitCapMs as an adaptive-wait cap but rename/keep it as a plain always-on knob only if it still earns its place (see the flag audit step) - otherwise inline its default. Remove the `fastLoop` option from RunGoalOptions/RunGoalContext, src/server.ts threading, and src/tools/run_goal.ts. Remove LAYA_FAST_LOOP + DEFAULT_FAST_LOOP + the fastLoop config field from src/config.ts and its doc comment. Preserve behavior for the KEPT path: the observed decision sequence and verified outcomes must be unchanged (the fast loop was designed to be a pure optimization + correctness guard, not a behavior change).

Update benchmark/before-after.mjs + benchmark/RESULTS.md so they no longer depend on toggling LAYA_FAST_LOOP (the before/after comparison is now moot because there is only one loop). Either repurpose bench:fastloop into a single-path timing run or remove it and its package.json script; whichever is cleaner. Do not leave a dangling script that sets a removed env var. Keep NO EM DASHES in any regenerated prose.

AUDIT THE LAYA_* FLAG SURFACE and prune. For EACH knob in src/config.ts, decide: keep (earns its place: a real, documented, tested operator need), inline (collapse to a sensible constant/default and drop the env var), or delete (dead/never-threaded/superseded). Strong deletion/inlining candidates to evaluate honestly (do not blindly delete - verify each is safe and keep the suite green): LAYA_FAST_LOOP + LAYA_FAST_WAIT_CAP_MS (fast loop collapse), and any flag that is parsed but never threaded into behavior or is only exercised by a test that exists solely to assert the flag. For each removal: delete the field from LayaBrowserConfig + ConfigOverrides + the parse block + the default consts + the doc-comment line at the top of config.ts, and every downstream reference (server.ts, run_goal.ts, loop.ts, tests). Run the full suite after EACH removal (or each small batch) and keep it green; if a removal breaks a meaningful test, keep the flag and record why in findings. Record the final kept/inlined/deleted ledger in findings.

CONSOLIDATE THE DECISION PIPELINE in src/autopilot/loop.ts into one readable flow with fewer branches, without changing behavior for the kept path: the pipeline is rule seed (policySeed) -> local model decide -> confidence check -> escalate-if-a-channel-exists -> else best-safe-progress (the FEAT-003 fix). Factor the per-step decision resolution into a single well-named helper if it reduces branching and improves readability. Keep src/types.ts PURE and config parsed once. Do NOT change the rules-first order or RULE_CONFIDENCE 0.97 (rules stay - option b).

After the reorg, run typecheck + build + full test. The suite must be green with the SAME meaningful coverage (fast-loop behavior tests like test/fast-loop.test.ts should be updated to assert the now-always-on behavior rather than the flag; do not just delete coverage - preserve the correctness assertions, drop only the flag-toggle scaffolding). Record the before/after flag count and the diffstat (lines deleted) in findings to show the deletion bias.
acceptance_criteria: LAYA_FAST_LOOP and the legacy browser-loop branch are gone: there is exactly one loop (the fast path, always on), and git grep for 'fastLoop'/'LAYA_FAST_LOOP'/'legacy' in src/ returns no live flag/branch (only, at most, historical prose that has been updated).
The LAYA_* env-knob surface is audited and pruned with a documented keep/inline/delete ledger in findings; every deletion keeps the suite green and is behavior-preserving for the kept path.

The decision pipeline in loop.ts reads as one flow (rules -> model -> escalate-if-channel -> best-safe-progress) with fewer branches; rules-first and RULE_CONFIDENCE 0.97 are unchanged; src/types.ts stays pure and config is still parsed once.
No dangling references to removed env vars in scripts/benchmarks/docs; package.json scripts are consistent.
pnpm run typecheck clean, pnpm run build exit 0, pnpm test green with preserved meaningful coverage (fast-loop correctness assertions kept, flag-toggle scaffolding removed).
findings records the net lines deleted (deletion bias) and the flag count before/after.
verification: bash -lc 'pnpm test' (green; fast-loop behavior still asserted, no flag toggle)
